description: PLANNED as its own grant: upload an object through the v2 objects API (roadmap §30.2 media.upload.init|sign|complete|abort, one grant because the steps share chained upload tokens): start a single presigned PUT or a resumable multipart session, send the bytes with the session token, then complete it (hash, quota and content-type checks, then ready) or abort it. The routes serve production today but Media's tenantAuth checks media.object.upload on them; a token holding only this id is refused until Media's guard accepts it.
